- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/21 (Sun) 22:48
- [USER] User asked for an explanation of different types of seafood and their nutritional benefits.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Salmon is an excellent source of omega-3 fatty acids, which reduce inflammation and improve heart health. It's also rich in protein, B vitamins, potassium, and selenium.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Shrimp is low in fat and high in protein, making it a nutritious option. It's also a good source of selenium, vitamin B12, and phosphorus.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Tuna is high in protein and a good source of omega-3 fatty acids. It's also rich in niacin, vitamin B12, and selenium.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Cod is high in protein and low in fat, making it a healthy choice. It's also a good source of vitamin B12, selenium, and phosphorus.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Sardines are a good source of omega-3 fatty acids, vitamin B12, and calcium. They're also low in mercury, making them a safe seafood option.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Mussels are high in protein, iron, and vitamin B12. They're also a good source of omega-3 fatty acids and selenium.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Crab is low in fat and high in protein. It's also a good source of vitamin B12, selenium, and phosphorus.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Lobster is low in fat and high in protein. It's also a good source of vitamin B12, selenium, and phosphorus.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Clams are high in iron and vitamin B12. They're also a good source of protein and selenium.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] All seafood is a rich source of essential minerals like zinc, copper, and iodine. However, some seafood can be high in mercury, so consumers need to pay attention to serving sizes and recommended limits.
- [USER] User expressed interest in recommendations for seafood types that are best for weight loss.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Several types of seafood are generally a good choice for weight loss since seafood tends to be low in calories and high in protein.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Salmon is a good choice for weight loss, with one 3-ounce serving containing around 120 to 150 calories.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Shrimp is low in calories, with around 30 calories per ounce and 6 grams of protein.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Tuna is an excellent source of protein, with around 25 grams of protein per 3 ounces and around 100 to 120 calories per 3-ounce serving.
